Title: xCatalog — properties filter catalogIds naming another catalog does not leave the store catalog
Preconditions: Runner-native. Needs a SECOND CATALOG THAT OWNS PROPERTIES THE STORE CATALOG DOES NOT: alias CATALOG_OTHER_WITH_PROPERTIES = AGENT-TEST-Physical-Excluded, a physical catalog outside the store, seeded by `npm run seed:catalog-edge`, holding one Catalog-type and one Product-type property the store's Query.properties never returns. Without it a wrong implementation and the right one give the same answer. The names of those properties are READ from the catalog through the admin API at run time (not typed) and asserted absent from BOTH the unfiltered and the widened result — a stronger discriminator than total equality alone. The unfiltered result is captured first as the oracle; the widened result must equal it. VCST-6251 fix build: XCatalog >= 3.1024.0-pr-115 (pre-fix 3.1023.0 returned 14 properties, all from the other catalog).
Steps:
[AUTH role=ADMIN_DEFAULT]
[REST-OP other_catalog_props]
  GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/catalogs/{{other_catalog}}?responseGroup=Full
[REST-EXEC other_catalog_props]
[REST-CAPTURE other_catalog_props.body.properties.0.name → OTHER_PROP_A]
[REST-CAPTURE other_catalog_props.body.properties.1.name → OTHER_PROP_B]
[AUTH role=ACME_BUYER]
[GQL-OP base]
  query { properties(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 100 types: [CATALOG, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, VARIATION] cultureName: "en-US") { totalCount items { id name propertyType } } }
[GQL-EXEC base]
[GQL-CAPTURE base.data.properties.totalCount → BASE_TOTAL]
[GQL-CAPTURE base.data.properties.items.0.id → BASE_FIRST_ID]
[GQL-OP widened]
  query { properties(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 100 types: [CATALOG, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, VARIATION] cultureName: "en-US" filter: "catalogIds:{{other_catalog}}") { totalCount items { id name propertyType } } }
[GQL-EXEC widened]
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ADMIN] each returned property resolves (GET /api/catalog/properties/{id}) to the store's catalog, none to {{other_catalog}} (KB-A7D0ED1F method); the other catalog's own properties come from GET /api/catalog/catalogs/{id}?responseGroup=Full
Failure_Signals: widened totalCount differs from the unfiltered total; the unfiltered first property is missing from the widened list; the widened list contains a property of the other catalog (by name, read from the admin API); errors[] non-empty
References: VCST-6251; xAPI; graphql-schema.md — Query.properties; KB-A7D0ED1F; vc-module-x-catalog#115; Archetype:SCOPE; Technique:EG

Title: xCatalog — properties query returns the store catalog's properties, honouring the types argument
Preconditions: Runner-native. Baseline for Query.properties, which no suite called before VCST-6251: after the criteria builder was reordered the query must still return a non-empty store-catalog list and still apply the types argument.
Steps:
[AUTH role=ACME_BUYER]
[GQL-OP product_types]
  query { properties(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 100 types: [PRODUCT] cultureName: "en-US") { totalCount items { id name propertyType } } }
[GQL-EXEC product_types]
[GQL-OP all_types]
  query { properties(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 100 types: [CATALOG, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, VARIATION] cultureName: "en-US") { totalCount items { id name propertyType } } }
[GQL-EXEC all_types]
[GQL-CAPTURE all_types.data.properties.totalCount → ALL_TOTAL]
Failure_Signals: totalCount 0; non-PRODUCT properties under types:[PRODUCT]; errors[] non-empty
References: VCST-6251; xAPI; graphql-schema.md — Query.properties; vc-module-x-catalog#115; Archetype:SCOPE; Technique:EP
